title: Good for 6 months only 😕
text: Good for 6 months only 😕. I have been using this bread maker for past 8 months. It worked fine for 6 months then I noticed  that bread does not turn golden at the top anymore and tasted a bit uncooked. I figured the heat is scraping from the lid since lid is too light weight. I experimented by putting a weight on top of the bread maker while in use and it resolved the issue. I believe if they make the lid a little heavier it will not get loose after just 6 month of use.
